text:
nina: quick thread to capture postmortem follow-ups for token hygiene + rotation automation. goal: clear ownership, short ETAs, and an async checkin cadence. please ack and add any missing items.

carlos: ack. i'll own validation hardening + canary rollout.

yuki: ack. i'll take the rotation-verification automation and the runbook update.

sam: i'll cover audit logs and alerts, plus dashboards.

nina: initial action items (brief):
- T1: stricter token validation (sig+kid+exp) + integration tests (owner: carlos, ETA: 10d)
- T2: rotation-verification job: preflight checks + post-rotate smoke (owner: yuki, ETA: 14d)
- T3: audit-log enrichment for auth flows + retention bump to 45d (owner: sam, ETA: 5d)
- T4: gating rule for rotation PRs that enforces verification job success (owner: yuki, ETA: 14d)
- T5: alerting and runbook link on token-failure spike (>0.3% / 15m) (owner: sam, ETA: 7d)
- T6: weekly rotation health job + monthly pulse report (owner: infra-bot/operator, ETA: 3d to schedule)
- T7: postmortem lessons added to infra runbook and a playbook entry for vendor certs (owner: nina, ETA: 7d)

yuki: rotation-verification plan sketch:
1) preflight: verify secret exists in all envs via ops-api call
2) post-merge: run smoke token-rotate -> validate tokens across 3 canary regions
3) rollback hook if verification fails in any region within 30m

example check command for preflight (will be a CI step):
```
# returns non-zero if secret missing in any env
ops-cli secrets verify --name=auth_key --env=all 
```

yuki: I'll add a PR with the job and the gating rule. target PR date: 2024-08-12.

carlos: For T1 i'll add an integration test and a canary rollout. test snippet: 
```
POST /auth/validate
{ "token": "eyJhbGciOi...bad-kid" }
expect: 401, log: validation.kid_mismatch
```
ETA for PR: 2024-08-08. will request @nina review.

sam: audit sampling proposal: increase auth_flow sampling to 40% for 30d, add fields: user_id, client_id, token_kid, validation_result. query we can add to dashboard: 
```
select count(*) as failures, bin(1m) from auth_events where validation_result != 'ok' group by bin(1m)
```
I'll wire the dashboard tile and add alert thresholds. PR for logging change: 2024-08-02.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2782: "rotation health job" with assignee: yuki. Due: 2024-08-14.

ops-bot: Calendar invite rotation-ops-checks created (Weds 09:30 PT) for weekly 8-week cadence.

nina: recurrence pattern note: ops reviewed last 9 monthswe observed clustering around vendor cert rotations and manual rotation windows. primary mitigation: stronger preflight + gating + automation health checks.

carlos: can we add a canary policy so that if any validation metric regresses in canary >0.2% we auto-block full rollout for 24h?

yuki: yes, that can be part of the gating rule (T4). i'll implement a simple metric-check step in the job.

sam: alerting details: page on-call at 0.5% validation failures sustained 15m; create high-priority channel #token-alerts for fast triage.

nina: decision summary: implement T1..T7, weekly rotation checks for 8 weeks, gating on PRs, dashboard + alerts. owners to label PRs with label "incident-1734567890-remediate" and drop links here.

yuki: PR for rotation job: https://redwood.internal/pull/4909 (WIP). includes gating config.

carlos: PR for validation hardening: https://redwood.internal/pull/4915 (draft).

sam: logging & dashboard PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/4911 (ready). added saved queries and alert rules.

nina: operational notes:
- run weekly rotation checks for 8 weeks, escalate if >1 production token failure incident in window
- if gating blocks >2 rotations in a week, open an incident and pause scheduled rotations until triage
- maintain rotation success rate metric; target >= 99.5% across envs

yuki: will instrument rotation success heartbeat metric: rotations.success_rate (1m resolution).

carlos: will run canary for 72h once PR is merged to be safe.

sam: added the short playbook to /docs/runbooks/token-rotations.md and linked in the alert.

ops-bot: Created reminder: "rotation-weekly-check" for next run 2024-07-31T09:30:00-07:00.

nina: please update the remediation tracker spreadsheet with PR links + final ETA. i'll close this thread once all PRs are linked and owners confirm. thanks all. :tada:
